title: Spike: Moonshine WASM feasibility for always-on browser listening
description:
Run the four feasibility tests in docs/VOICE.md with throwaway code under spikes/.

Feature: Always-on voice listening is feasible in the browser
  Scenario: Moonshine Tiny Streaming runs under cross-origin isolation
    Given a page served with COOP same-origin and COEP require-corp
    And Moonshine model files served same-origin
    When the page transcribes recorded speech with Tiny Streaming
    Then completed lines arrive and end-of-speech-to-line latency is recorded
    And CPU and memory over a sustained run are recorded
    And the results are written to docs/VOICE.md

Not included: production code in web/, infra changes.
